data: unchanged registered train F1/F3 and validation F2 only; all consumed F4 and earlier independent labels permanently excluded
crossfit_unit: entire training capture/source context, retaining all four target variants; F1 predicts withheld F3, F3 predicts withheld F1
calibration: max(1, validation actual/raw, training-context-crossfit actual/raw)*1.05, then +1.5ps; raw denominator floor1.5ps
reserve_basis: use the existing predeclared max-ratio plus1.05 guard architecture from earlier calibration protocols; scale is calculated solely from train/validation and training group crossfit
selection: same operation/stage error and false-feasible gates after reserve; then MAE, p95, serialized size, stable algorithm name
area: inherit the exact pretest v2 area choices and numbers; this successor revises delay calibration only
new_independent_test: fresh F5 real capture-bank/source contexts at the same exposed widths and original four SDC targets; freeze choices and reproduce before launch
independence_claim: new load/source contexts, not unseen widths; F5 beyond training maximum3 is explicitly measured and never assumed covered
